title: Quick review of Rough Country Soft Top Tonneau Cover
description:
Okay so I've had this Rough Country soft top cover for my F-150 Lightning for about a year and half now, and can safely say that it is a great bang for your buck. It keeps most rain/water out of the bed, install was a BREEZE, and it's just a fraction of the price of some other "bigger" name brands. I highly recommend this product. 

Amazon 🔗 https://amzn.to/4z67yG1

title: Shure SM58 Microphone Review
description:
Look, I'm not a seasoned musician, just an average amateur. But, I LOVE the way this microphone feels. I honestly couldn't get over it while doing the video review. If you need a solid entry-ish level mic, this is the one for you. Note my one minor gripe in the video. 

Amazon 🔗 https://amzn.to/47hOsQN

title: My quick demonstration of the Fender FCT-2 Clip-On Tuner
description:
This is a quick demo/review of the Fender FCT-2 tuner that can easily clip on to your guitar, violin, bass, etc. I've personally owned this tuner for 4+ years and it's been fantastic and accurate. Bonus, I haven't had to change the battery yet! 

I would definitely recommend this tuner as an entry-level accessory for the beginning musician. 

Amazon 🔗 https://amzn.to/4jZh74u
